1.explanation:
• readme.md: Contains the exact section “Testing on a mobile device” the user followed.  
• emulation.md: Documents how screenEmulation and device metrics are applied (and what disabling them should do).  
• configuration.md: Explains Lighthouse CLI flags like --screenEmulation.disabled and --no-emulatedUserAgent that control emulation behavior.  
• throttling.md: Describes network throttling (Slow 4G) labels seen in the header.  
• understanding-results.md: Details how Lighthouse builds the report header and labels runs (e.g. “Emulated Moto G4”), which is where the mismatch occurs.
1.bug_scenario: The user followed the “Testing on a mobile device” instructions in the main README and ran Lighthouse directly against Chrome on a Moto Power G phone (via remote debugging), disabling screen emulation and using a real device user-agent. However, the generated report’s header still labels the run as “Emulated Moto G4” (with Slow 4G throttling, Lighthouse 9.6.8), when it should indicate that the audit was performed on a real/physical device.
